facts.text: The Patriot Promise covers 100% of tuition and mandatory fees for eligible Texas resident first-time freshmen and transfer students with household incomes of $100,000 or less.

sources.title: Patriot Promise Program - UT Tyler
sources.quote: The Patriot Promise program covers tuition and mandatory fees for eligible students with a FAFSA-reported household income of $100,000 or less.

sources.title: Patriot Promise Program - UT Tyler
sources.quote: Be a Texas resident. Be a new Freshman or incoming Transfer student.
